title: The 10 Best Chinese Carbon Road Bike Wheels TESTED (2026)
notes: Updated 6 July 2026 by Petr Minarik; affiliate links and a YOELEO discount code. Names the YOELEO NxT SL2 range "Best Value for Money" after testing the C60 depth, not the C35 (overall 4.2/5); the tester could not seat a tubeless tire on the C60 without an air compressor. Lists a 105 kg rider limit, which differs from the maker's 125 kg system limit.
